rule: Server sends one countdown value; client stores it (value times 32), decrements one per game step while above 1, and draws it as m:ss while non-zero. Hit visibility is one per-character counter set to 200 steps on hit; the health bar draws while above 0 and the damage number while above 150. Death sets a 250-step screen timer that fades the screen and clears mouse input until it runs out. Step target is 20 ms (set to 50 per second).
keep: Server owns the number; client counts down and draws it only
One per-character hit counter with thresholds picks the health bar and the damage number
Death as a short fade with input held, then two plain messages
Countdown as one bottom-centre HUD line in a readable bold face
change: Server sends an end-time (steps or ms), not a value the client decrements, so late packets self-correct
Banner hides at or below one unit and on zone change (fixes D1)
Send the 32-unit quantum only on the wire; display at the real step rate (fixes D2, D4)
Danger band (2203, 2640) moves from client constants to zone data (fixes D3)
Death durations come from zone or Pit data, not one constant
look_test: On a 375-wide phone in a duel, show 'Event in 0:12' bottom-centre counting down. Version A stays at 0:00 (donor). Version B hides at zero with a short stinger. Judge readability at arm's length, whether it steals the fight, and whether hiding at zero reads as the event ending. Then try a 3 s and a 5 s death fade and pick one.
